title: Summer and Promise
author: Xanthe Whitlock
blurb: Wendell Eastwick, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
